title: Live failure, recovery and rotation acceptance
goal: Live failure, recovery and rotation acceptance
acceptance: Lost reply, Keychain failure, revocation and offline TLS/auth rotation exercised on the real host; evidence recorded
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Owner-observed result recorded in the parent record
escalation: Owner action: this step needs the owner's access, choice or observation

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1 hour agent + 0.5 hours owner; agent drives the failure cases; the owner gives host access for rotation. Method: NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge: median 0.56 h, p75 2.1 h, p90 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement) put a focused day at about 1.5 agent hours, with 0.75 h the least for one PR with review and CI. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history.
